Name: Eric Pederson
Question: Is Tim Walz a helpful choice for Kamala Harris as VP?
Answer: I’m going to be perfectly straight with you all, as a dude whose spidey senses were tingling for Pete Buttigieg — when Donald Trump posted, apropos of nothing at 2AM on like Saturday or Sunday morning that he *was not weird*, I just felt the momentum for Pete shift away. I still always thought he was the safe choice, but IF it was going to be a governor, the ONLY one that made ANY sense was Walz. And the fact that Walz managed to get into Trump’s head so completely really made me secretly think it was probably going to be him if it wasn’t Pete. How could it not be? For sure his stock went interstellar. Anyone who can so thoroughly fuck with the enemy like that is an unbelievable asset to have on the team. Pete’s strengths were fearlessness in hostile environments and an unshakable ability to stay on message under intense pressure. Walz’s talents are that he’s a phenomenal public speaker and he’s insanely relatable. He comes off as just a regular fuckin’ guy who cares about his neighbors regardless of their race, sexual orientation, gender identity, creed, religion, etc. He’s got mass appeal. The way he got people fired up in Philly was really special and I honestly do not think Pete Buttigieg could have done that, and I’ll freely admit it. Walz even exceeded my expectations with his speech. And note HE DID NOT USE TELEPROMPTERS (at least none that I could see). The thing that tipped me off to that was when he froze momentarily and was trying to think of an adjective to describe Harris and landed on “compassionate leader.” That’s just raw ability. You can’t teach that. I have played live rock gigs before and when you break a string on a solo you just gotta make do…you can’t stop — the show has to continue. If you’re an artist, you have to make the audience think you meant to do it. If you break a string, sell it as if you are so into the music the instrument is giving out under your fingers…ya know? That’s what Walz did. Because humans fuck up, mistakes happen, we forget our lines…it’s human. Roll with it. The energy that dude brought was just fucking CRAZY. And then his couch comment. He’s an expert-level troll. This is going to be a fun 3 months watching the GOP completely come unglued lobbing grenades at Harris and Walz and seeing NOTHING HAPPEN TO THEM. The Harris-Biden team absolutely crushed this VP pick into the upper deck. Fuck that, they blasted it into out of Target Field, over downtown Minneapolis, and into the Mississippi. Jesus fucking Christ, what a great pick.
